internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:20 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service, with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds, exceeding the 1-second threshold. CPU utilization was observed to be very high at 98% of its limit, indicating resource exhaustion as a contributing factor. A trace span confirmed slow response times of up to 2400 ms.

The diagnosis confirmed that resource exhaustion due to high CPU usage was the root cause of the latency. The mitigation involved disabling the flag responsible for high CPU usage in the ad service at 11:40 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-mitigation monitoring verified recovery with latency dropping to 0.12 seconds.

The incident is now resolved. Further analysis and lessons learned are documented in the postmortem section.
